seoTitle: Central Australia Marketing | Local SEO | GT Marketing
seoDescription: Darwin-based local SEO, websites and lead generation for small and medium businesses across Central Australia and the NT.

hero.heading: Local marketing for
hero.intro: GT Marketing is based in Darwin, not Alice Springs. We help small and medium businesses in Central Australia with local SEO, websites and lead-generation systems, mostly by remote work from Darwin.

servicesHeading: Practical marketing for businesses that are a long way from the agency.
servicesIntro: A Central Australian business still needs to show up when locals search, and still needs a website that explains the offer. We do that work from Darwin and agree any travel before it happens.

services.title: Local SEO
services.description: Help your business show up for the town and the services you actually offer, including the Google profile and the pages that support it.

services.title: Websites
services.description: A straightforward site for phone and desktop that says what you do, where you work and how to enquire.

services.title: Lead generation
services.description: Forms, calls and follow-up that a small team can keep using after the project is handed over.

services.title: Tradies and local services
services.description: Trade and home-service businesses that want enquiries from their own area, not a broad national campaign.

services.title: Hospitality and tourism operators
services.description: Venues and operators that need accurate visitor information and a clear way to book or make contact.

services.title: Health and professional services
services.description: Clinics, NDIS providers and professional firms that need a clear, trustworthy page and a simple enquiry path.

localHeading: Central Australia is a service area, not a second office.
localParagraphs: GT Marketing's only stated office is 130 Smith Street, Darwin City. We do not describe Alice Springs or anywhere else in Central Australia as a GT Marketing office.
Work is usually remote: phone, video and shared documents. Travel is optional and only goes ahead when the need, timing and cost are agreed.
We will not promise a ranking, a lead target or a funding outcome. You get an agreed scope.
industriesHeading: Businesses we can help in Central Australia
serviceAreaNote: Remote delivery is available across Central Australia. Travel is subject to the project, timing and an agreed cost. There is no GT Marketing office in the region.

faqs.question: Do you have an office in Central Australia?
faqs.answer: No. GT Marketing is based at 130 Smith Street, Darwin City. Central Australia is a service area.

faqs.question: Can the project be run from Darwin?
faqs.answer: Yes. That is the usual arrangement. A visit can be added if it helps and the travel is agreed first.

faqs.question: Which businesses do you work with?
faqs.answer: Small and medium businesses, including tradies, hospitality, health and NDIS providers, and professional services. The fit is confirmed on a call.

closing.heading: Book a call. We will tell you plainly whether we can help.
